name: tgpu-htj2k
description: WebGPU HTJ2K (JPEG 2000 Part 15) codec — Rust/wasm CPU core + TypeScript/TypeGPU GPU layer.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust/htj2k-core --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name htj2k_core
scripts.build:wasm:dev: wasm-pack build rust/htj2k-core --dev --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name htj2k_core
